_note: v2 2026-11-14. v1 (configs/policy_v1_mail_only.json, frozen before results) found NO household with positive expected value for mailed coupons (reports/portfolio_v1_mail_only.json). v2 adds a low-cost digital channel and an explicit deployment scale so fixed costs are evaluated at a realistic pilot size. Margin, redemption and uplift assumptions are UNCHANGED from v1.
category_selection_rule: Food categories with 4-week household penetration between 12% and 55% (weeks 46-49 scan), high annual sales, and coupons present in at least 4 historical campaigns. Excluded: fuel, COUPON/MISC ITEMS, alcohol and tobacco (guardrail: no promotional targeting of age-restricted goods), fresh meat (stock/perishability risk with no inventory data).

temporal.time_unit: week (1..53; week 1 is a single day and is never a label week)
temporal.eligibility: household has >= 1 basket in the 12 lookback weeks (existing active household, decided with pre-cutoff data only)

segments.REGULAR: bought the category in >= 3 of the last 12 weeks
segments.RECENT_LIGHT: bought in 1-2 of the last 12 weeks, at least once in the last 4 weeks
segments.LAPSING: bought in weeks -12..-5 but not in the last 4 weeks
segments.ACTIVE_NONBUYER: no category purchase in 12 weeks but >= 6 store baskets in 12 weeks

budget_cap.unit: USD per 4-week pilot at deployment scale

redemption_share_of_buyers.unit: share of contacted buyers who redeem

coupon_face_value.status: OBSERVED (historical mean coupon discount per couponed line in category)

incremental_purchase_rate.status: ASSUMED (subjective ranges; replace with pilot estimate). Absolute probability points added to 4-week category purchase.

min_reach_per_plan.status: POLICY (households at deployment scale; smaller cells cannot support a holdout)

stock_capacity.status: UNKNOWN (no inventory data; human capacity check required)

reach_share.status: ASSUMED (share with digital consent; UNKNOWN in data)

deployment_scale.unit: real households represented per panel household

outcome_rule.primary_metric: incremental contribution per randomized eligible household after coupon and contact cost, 28 days
outcome_rule.expand_if: 95% CI lower bound > 0 and all guardrails pass
outcome_rule.stop_if: 95% CI upper bound < 0 or any guardrail fails
outcome_rule.change_if: point estimate > 0 but CI includes 0 and guardrails pass
